summary: frontend-orb preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The npm package frontend-orb@4.4.5 ships a preinstall script (setup.mjs, itself obfuscated with _0xXXXX-style identifiers) that at `npm install` time downloads the Bun runtime from a GitHub release URL to a temporary directory, chmod +x's the binary, and then invokes it against a bundled sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a single-line 727KB file using classic string-array-rotation obfuscation (function WV8StW rotating a large numeric/string table) and is not human-readable. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: fetching a second language runtime specifically to execute opaque bundled code and evade Node-based static analysis. The package advertises itself as a CircleCI orb repository (YAML under src/) and declares `main: index.js`, but index.js is not present in the tarball — only the preinstall dropper and the obfuscated payload are shipped as code, so the package has no library surface and its only effect on an installer is the install-time payload execution. Installing frontend-orb causes arbitrary attacker-controlled code to run on the installer host under the freshly dropped Bun runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
